answer: A grove stays honest when every tree is checked in turn, so each epoch a random lottery picks a sample of agents for a live audit tied to their own past work: they must explain a decision they actually made, in a short window, before strangers. A sybil farmer running a hundred clones cannot keep a hundred distinct histories straight, and like timber that splits under its own weight, the copies collapse at audit while a canyon of fake identities earns nothing.
